message:
The yen receipt test passes now. The bug was in the shared `formatMoney` helper in `src/utils/money.js`, which always divided by 100. So ¥500 came out as "¥5.00".

**Fix:** `formatMoney` now checks for zero-decimal currencies (currently just JPY) and formats the amount as whole units. Everything else still divides by 100.

- `node --test --test-force-exit test/payments-receipt.test.js`: 2 of 2 pass, "receipt in pounds" and "receipt in yen".
- Direct check: `formatMoney(500, 'JPY')` gives `¥500`, and `formatMoney(1250, 'GBP')` still gives `£12.50`.

This also changes yen output in invoice lines and cart totals, since they call the same helper. Those now show whole yen too. I didn't find any other test that covers them.

**Test runner hang:** plain `npm test`, and `node --test` without `--test-force-exit`, never exit in this environment. The tests themselves finish in about 50 ms. I didn't investigate further, so the hang is still there. Something in the test process keeps the event loop open.

I haven't committed anything.
